ارتضيتم (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَيْتُمْ (irtaḍaytum) /ir.ta.dˤaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اُرْتُضِيتُمْ (urtuḍītum) /ur.tu.dˤiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
